Here are five good weekend treks from Pune, with rough costs per person. The costs are my estimates, not live prices.

Trek	From Pune	Difficulty	Rough cost
Sinhagad	About 35 km	Easy	₹200–₹500
Lohagad and Visapur	About 65 km	Easy	₹300–₹700
Rajmachi	About 90 km	Easy to moderate	₹800–₹1,500
Torna	About 70 km	Moderate to hard	₹1,000–₹1,800
Harishchandragad	About 150 km	Hard	₹1,500–₹2,500

The low end is going on your own (transport and food). The high end is a group trek with a guide, and overnight stays push it up. The weather should be good this Sat 31 Oct and Sun 1 Nov, after the monsoon.
